historical_evidence.note: Estimator and temperature-era ablations remain historical records and include an explicit mapping to the current API.

known_boundaries: Backward remains dense O(T^2); candidate pruning is prohibited in the default training operator.
The VJP is a useful dense surrogate, not the mathematical derivative of exact hard routing.
Dropout changes backward exploration only; it cannot make the hard forward differentiable.
No matched fitting cell exceeded 7/8; the synthetic matrix is not evidence of universal pretraining benefit.
The static scale and mismatch_scale defaults are empirical and are not universally optimal.
A high mismatch_scale can suppress discovery of long near matches; scale cannot restore vanished suffix products.
FP16 can underflow long-tail route gradients; use loss scaling or FP32 projections when full support matters.
CUDA atomic accumulation is numerically reproducible within tolerance, not bitwise deterministic.
Full-model pretraining at realistic depth and context has not yet been completed.
